direct_answer: Aker BP states that it does not have a climate change mitigation transition plan that is in line with ESRS requirements, because it has no targets to reduce scope 3 emissions; it also states it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop such a plan [Source 1]. Therefore, the undertaking does not disclose a 1.5°C-aligned transition plan under ESRS E1-1, and no adoption timeline is provided [Source 1]. Separately, Aker BP discloses it has developed a “decarbonisation plan” (publicly available on its website), but the retrieved passages do not provide its content or demonstrate 1.5°C alignment [Source 4]. Aker BP also discloses its climate-related targets are not science-based and are not externally assured [Source 4], which does not support a claim of 1.5°C alignment.
compliance_rationale: The company explicitly discloses it does not have an ESRS-compliant climate transition plan and has no timeline to develop one [Source 1], which fails ESRS E1-1. It also states its climate-related targets are not science-based and not externally assured [Source 4], and the retrieved passages do not include an explanation of compatibility with limiting warming to 1.5°C as required by ESRS E1-1/E1-4.
disclosure_gaps: A transition plan for climate change mitigation meeting ESRS E1-1 content requirements (beyond the statement that it is not in place) [Source 1].
Explanation of how GHG emission reduction targets are compatible with limiting global warming to 1.5°C (including linkage to E1-4 targets) [Source 1, Source 4].
If no transition plan exists, a timeline for adopting one (explicitly stated as not available) [Source 1].

E1-4 details on 1.5°C compatibility: framework/methodology used, underlying climate and policy scenarios used to set targets, and whether targets have been externally assured (company states targets are not science-based and not externally assured; no methodology/scenario basis for target-setting is provided in the retrieved passages) [Source 4].
Content of the referenced publicly available “decarbonisation plan” and whether it constitutes a transition plan and is 1.5°C aligned (not included in retrieved passages) [Source 4].
key_findings: Aker BP states it does not have a climate transition plan in line with ESRS requirements and has no timeline for developing one [Source 1].
Aker BP states it has no targets to reduce scope 3 emissions, which it cites as the reason it lacks an ESRS-aligned transition plan [Source 1].
Aker BP reports it has developed a decarbonisation plan (publicly available on its website), but the retrieved passages do not provide details or 1.5°C alignment evidence [Source 4].
Aker BP states its climate-related targets are not science-based and are not externally assured [Source 4].
